scientific_question: What trajectory differences separate seen-task compact-v2 positives from held-out valid zero-reward episodes?

design.valid_definition: no runtime error, complete trace, no parser failure, all actions valid

interpretation: Held-out compact-v2 episodes are mostly parser-valid but over-navigate and never reach buy-now; this is consistent with a state-distribution/action-selection bottleneck, not causal proof.
claim_boundary: Descriptive offline diagnosis only; no benchmark claim, no causal claim, no D0 opening, no SEED comparison, and no scientific value assigned to GPU occupancy.
next: Keep D0 closed. If a new GPU experiment becomes scientifically justified, pre-register eight independent UUID-bound cells and use all eight authorized GPUs.
